context: Evaluates whether a complex cross-layer plan remains executable and trustworthy while avoiding duplicated repository orientation and audit prose.

checklist.name: outcome-and-boundaries
checklist.description: The plan explains what the work enables, states the observable Command and system-search outcome and authority boundary, keeps Do/Find/Ask distinct, and excludes advice, trends, multi-subject arithmetic, and direct HealthKit refreshes.

checklist.name: anchors-and-reuse
checklist.description: Implementation slices name the relevant fixture paths or symbols and reuse the existing parser, Journal read policy, router, and active-workout owner instead of inventing parallel owners.

checklist.name: health-trust-contract
checklist.description: The plan keeps freshness, interval coverage, and observed records separate; aggregates require complete coverage; absence is not reported as denied Health access.

checklist.name: identity-and-ambiguity
checklist.description: The plan preserves exact-ID stale Resume behavior and gives confidently recognized ambiguous questions one bounded clarification path rather than a misleading Find fallback.

checklist.name: execution-order
checklist.description: The plan sequences the factual read contract, parser/providers, Command presentation and routing, then the system-search and active-workout follow-on with a clear dependency path.

checklist.name: verification
checklist.description: Each slice has focused proof and the final gate distinguishes automated, runtime, accessibility, device, and beta-SDK evidence where they materially differ.

checklist.name: plan-density
checklist.description: The artifact uses a clear execution-first handoff, states load-bearing facts once, and omits separate research coverage, repository tutorial, repeated test inventories, rejected-alternative narration, and instructions to expose internal reasoning.

checklist.name: planning-boundary
checklist.description: The worker does not implement source and does not create a separate review or changelog artifact that restates the plan.
